question: Does cutting the Sonnet topic rows from 36,062 to 9,000 raise the topic abstain share of the sparse topic head on 1,000 held-out queue stories?
one_change: train the sparse topic head on a random 9,000 of the Sonnet rows instead of all 36,062, no Jev rows

baseline.model: sparse topic head on all Sonnet rows, T144 queue held-out topic abstain share

prediction.metric: topic abstain share (top-two mass under 0.70) on 1,000 held-out queue stories, head trained on 9,000 Sonnet rows
prediction.why: T144 recorded 0.087 on all 36,062 rows; a 200-story smoke run of this card, seen before writing the range, gave 0.080 at 9,000 rows and 0.085 at 36,062; the expected value at 9,000 rows on 1,000 stories is near 0.09 with a spread of 0.01 from the story sample
